sections.text: DEK::NUP214 bound regulatory regions of FOXC1 and HOXA/HOXB genes in cellular models. XPO1 inhibition reduced fusion-associated binding and expression of these leukemia-associated transcriptional targets, including in primary t(6;9) AML samples.

audit_evidence.location: Results and Discussion: XPO1-dependent transcription factor; Figure 2B-F; PDF pages 4-6
audit_evidence.scope: Direct CUT&RUN and perturbation evidence; XPO1 inhibitor sensitivity is experimental and not a fusion-specific approved treatment.

sections.text: DEK::NUP214 AML is in the adverse genetic-risk group under adult ELN 2022 intensive-treatment criteria.
